summary: Bug fix verification: /app/frontend/src/notifications.ts Expo Go detection + regression smoke. Code review PASSED: isExpoGo correctly derived from Constants.executionEnvironment === ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient; setNotificationHandler guarded by (!isExpoGo && Platform.OS !== 'web'); both requestPermission() and scheduleReminders() early-return when isExpoGo || Platform.OS === 'web'. Preview loads cleanly on web: login screen renders with testID 'google-signin-button' ('Accedi con Google') and no notifications-related crash. Backend regression smoke 3/3 PASSED (GET /api/ 200, GET /api/auth/me 401 w/o token, POST /api/auth/session invalid 401). SEPARATE PRE-EXISTING BUG detected (unrelated to this fix): navigating to /setup or /settings on web triggers red-screen 'ExpoSecureStore.default.deleteValueWithKeyAsync is not a function' from src/api/client.ts:22 (SecureStore.deleteItemAsync called inside setToken(null) during 401 handling). Reporting for main agent.

integration_issues.flow: Navigate to /setup or /settings on web preview while unauthenticated (401 from /api/auth/me triggers client.setToken(null) -> SecureStore.deleteItemAsync).
integration_issues.issue: Red-screen Uncaught Error 'ExpoSecureStore.default.deleteValueWithKeyAsync is not a function'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts:22. expo-secure-store on web does not implement deleteItemAsync. Guard with Platform.OS === 'web' using AsyncStorage/localStorage fallback, or wrap in try/catch. This is PRE-EXISTING, not introduced by the notifications.ts fix.

react_native_issues.issue: SecureStore.deleteItemAsync throws on web (expo-secure-store web shim). Reference: /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts:22. Add Platform.OS === 'web' guard with localStorage/AsyncStorage fallback. Not caused by notifications fix but visible in preview.

Benign: on web, 'import * as Notifications from "expo-notifications"' emits warnings 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Not a crash; just noise. Could be further mitigated via a conditional dynamic import if a cleaner console is desired. Reference: /app/frontend/src/notifications.ts:1.

action_items: Fix src/api/client.ts setToken(null) for web: guard SecureStore.deleteItemAsync with Platform.OS !== 'web' or wrap in try/catch; mirror the same for setItemAsync/getItemAsync. This currently red-screens the preview whenever any /api call returns 401 (very common during routing between protected screens).
(Optional) Lazy/conditional import of expo-notifications in notifications.ts to silence web warnings about push-token listeners.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.ts fix is correct and minimal: isExpoGo detection via Constants.executionEnvironment === ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient matches Expo SDK 53+ recommendation; both exported functions are no-ops on Expo Go and web; handler registration is also skipped on both; try/catch around schedule logic prevents unexpected crashes.
settings.tsx (line 61) and setup.tsx (lines 77-78) call the guarded helpers unconditionally — this is fine because the helpers themselves short-circuit; no caller-side change needed.
Pre-existing: src/api/client.ts has no web/SecureStore guard — crashes on 401 flow in preview.

success_rate.frontend: notifications fix verified; separate SecureStore red-screen reproducible

rca_of_issue: Original notifications.ts crash RCA: in Expo SDK 53+ Expo Go removed push notification APIs; calling Notifications.scheduleNotificationAsync / setNotificationHandler in Expo Go can throw. The fix detects Expo Go via Constants.executionEnvironment === ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient and short-circuits all three touch points (handler registration, requestPermission, scheduleReminders). It also short-circuits on Platform.OS === 'web' because the preview runs as React Native Web, where expo-notifications is only partially implemented. VERIFIED: preview no longer crashes on load; login screen reachable. Secondary RCA (separate issue): expo-secure-store web shim lacks deleteItemAsync; calling it from setToken(null) during 401 handling throws 'deleteValueWithKeyAsync is not a function' — needs Platform guard in src/api/client.ts.
